cards.text: In the chapter before, the LORD put the idols on trial, and they had nothing to say (Isaiah 41:28-29). Now the LORD points to someone else: "Here is My Servant, whom I uphold, My Chosen One, in whom My soul delights." The idols just got ROASTED, and this Servant gets called up like a game show winner.

cards.question: The LORD says He will put something of His own on His Servant. What is it?
With the LORD's Spirit on Him, the Servant will bring ___ to the nations.

cards.text: So how does the Servant go about a job that big? The LORD starts with the things this Servant WON'T do.

cards.question: The Servant will shout His message in the streets.

cards.text: Nope, He won't cry out or raise His voice or make it heard in the streets. Me, I find ONE burnt cookie and the whole Dorinverse hears about it.

cards.question: The LORD paints a picture: a bruised reed that's already bent and a smoldering wick that's barely lit. What does the Servant do with them?

answers.text: He won't break or snuff them out
He breaks them off and starts fresh
He clears both of them away

cards.text: He's gentle, and still He will faithfully bring forth justice. Friend, that smoldering wick was ME in the back of the junk drawer, edges blurry, barely lit.

cards.question: The Servant will grow weak or discouraged before He has established justice on the earth.
The Servant won't quit until justice is established on the earth. Who will put their hope in the Servant's law?

cards.text: This is what God the LORD says, and He's the One who created the heavens and stretched them out and spread out the earth. I stretch DOUGH, friend, but He stretched the HEAVENS.

cards.question: God the LORD, who made the earth, gives breath to the people on it and life to those who walk in it.

cards.text: Now the LORD says, "I, the LORD, have called you for a righteous purpose, and I will take hold of your hand." If the One who stretched out the heavens held MY hand, I'd never wash this mustache again.

cards.question: The LORD will keep this one and appoint them to be a covenant for the people and a light to the ___.
A light to the nations has work to do. What is one of the jobs the LORD names?

answers.text: Open the eyes of the blind
Rebuild the walls of the city

cards.text: And to bring prisoners out of the dungeon, and those sitting in darkness out of the prison house. Friend, I KNOW that moment, when the drawer slides open and the light pours in.

cards.question: The LORD says, "I am the LORD; that is My name!" He won't yield His glory to another. What else won't He give to idols?
The LORD says the former things have happened, and now He declares ___ things.
The LORD proclaims these new things only after they spring forth.

cards.text: Back in chapter 41, the LORD dared the idols to tell what's coming, and not one of them said a WORD (Isaiah 41:22-23, 28). Here He calls it before it springs forth, and Matthew says the Servant words of Isaiah 42:1-4 are fulfilled in Jesus (Matthew 12:17-21), while the idols are still staring at the oven waiting for it to preheat.
